Our mission

Built by farmers, for farmers. Our mission is to give every farmer access to the infrastructure and equipment that makes their land productive — sourced directly, priced honestly, with nothing hidden in between.

Why Andrivo exists

Farmers usually pay for a chain of markups they never see.

Andrivo was started by farmers, for farmers. We've felt firsthand what it costs when equipment passes through a factory, an export agent, an importer, and a local distributor — each one adding a markup nobody discloses.

Andrivo removes that chain. We work directly with international manufacturers, manage the shipping, customs and paperwork ourselves, and deliver the equipment straight to your farm, anywhere in Southern Africa. Our only charge is our service fee on top of the true cost: 30%, or 25% if you come through an Andrivo farmer's referral code. It's shown to you before you order, not folded into a price you can't verify.

After the sale

My Farm by Andrivo

Every machine you buy from us is logged against your farm — purchase dates, serial numbers and service history — so we can support you faster, without you having to dig up an invoice or a part number.

Ask us about your farm's record

Self-service access — signing in yourself to see your equipment or order parts — isn't live yet. For now, WhatsApp or call us and we'll pull up your record for you.

What we're keeping for you

  • Your equipment, with purchase dates, serial numbers and warranty status
  • Service history, so we know when parts are due before you do
  • Manuals for your machines, ready to send on request
  • A record you can just ask for — no self-service login yet, just WhatsApp or call us
What we source

Examples of what we source

Irrigation, crop & tillage equipment, power & workshop gear, gardening & grounds care machinery, cleaning equipment and farm vehicles — all imported directly from manufacturers, quoted against real factory specs and shipped with full documentation. Filters

Keep sand, algae and silt out of your system, from borehole separators to automatic self-cleaning filters. One catalog covers the full range.

Full range
Irrigation filtration

Sand, disc, screen and self-cleaning filters, up to 4 000 m³/h

Complete filtration head-works for any water source: sand media filters for dams and rivers, hydrocyclones for boreholes, and automatic disc, screen and brush filters that clean themselves without stopping the water.

  • Automatic sand media filters, 2–4 tanks, up to 320 m³/h
  • Automatic disc filter batteries, 2–7 heads, up to 420 m³/h
  • Hydraulic screen filters that backwash on line pressure alone, up to 1 500 m³/h
  • Electric brush self-cleaning filters for dirty dam and river water, up to 4 000 m³/h
  • Hydrocyclone sand separators, semi-automatic screen filters and 50–500 L fertiliser tanks

Valves

Hydraulic, solenoid, pressure-control and air valves. One accessories catalog covers the full range.

Full range
Valves

Control, pressure and air valves, ¾" to 6"

Plastic hydraulic valves that open, close and hold pressure on your mains and blocks, driven by 12 V DC latching or 24 V AC solenoids, plus air valves that protect pipes while they fill and drain.

  • Hydraulic main valves, T- and Y-type, threaded, flanged or VIC-grooved
  • Solenoid on/off valves and motorised solenoid pilots, 12 V DC latching or 24 V AC
  • Pressure reducing, sustaining, relief and proportional valves, up to 10 bar
  • Kinetic and combination air valves, ¾" to 2"

Solar pump inverters

Run irrigation and borehole pumps straight from solar panels, with grid or generator back-up. One catalog covers the full range.

Full range
Solar pump inverters

EN750PV solar pump inverters, 0.75–90 kW

Pump water from the sun with no batteries. The inverter tracks the panels' maximum power all day, starts and stops with the sunlight and protects the pump, so a borehole or dam pump runs itself.

  • 0.75–90 kW, 380 V three-phase output, for induction and permanent-magnet pumps
  • MPPT solar tracking with efficiency up to 99%, plus constant-pressure PID control
  • Optional AC/DC switching module for grid or generator back-up, 24/7
  • Dry-run, low-frequency, overcurrent and lightning protection, with automatic sleep and wake-up
  • Panel-string recommendations for every model in the catalog
WhatsApp

Frequency inverters

Variable-speed drives for irrigation pumps, boreholes and fans. One catalog covers the full range.

Full range
Frequency inverters

EN760 inverters for pumps and fans, 0.75–500 kW

Run pumps and fans at the speed the job needs instead of flat out. Constant-pressure water supply, multi-pump control and a built-in PID controller cut electricity use and protect pipes from water hammer.

  • 380 V three-phase, 0.75–500 kW, for fan/pump and heavy-duty loads
  • One drive can run up to four pumps; up to five drives can be networked for constant-pressure supply
  • Sleep/wake-up energy saving and broken-pipe protection
  • Drives induction and permanent-magnet motors, with Modbus RTU built in
  • Wall-mounted up to 185 kW (IP20); cabinet-mounted above that

Need something else? We can source it.

The catalogue above covers water systems, crop protection, generators, tillage and implements, potato equipment, ride-on and grounds care, gearboxes and motors — but that's not the limit. We can source almost any agricultural equipment from international manufacturers, including processing equipment such as packhouse lines, graders, sorters, dryers and cold-room equipment. Ask us to source it
The process

What happens after you get in touch

Tell us what you need

Share the equipment, quantity and your farm's location. Not sure what fits your setup? We'll ask the right questions.

We source & quote

We get pricing from vetted manufacturers and send you the full breakdown — factory price, import cost, and our service fee.

We check it before it ships

Before we pay the balance, the goods are inspected against your order: model, specification, quantity and condition, with photos sent to you.

We handle the import

Shipping, customs clearance and documentation are managed on our end. You don't deal with a single import agent.

Delivered and checked

We check the load again before it leaves for your farm, and you sign it off on arrival — right items, right quantity, no damage.

Andrivo vs. traditional retailers

The same equipment, without the markup chain

Real prices for equipment our farmers use, bought through a local retailer compared with ordering through Andrivo.

Traditional retailer Through Andrivo

Irrigation design

We work out what your system needs

Tell us about your land and water, and we'll use irrigation design software to work out the right pump, filters, mainline, valves and drippers for your farm, then quote the complete system.

Send us your details Or WhatsApp us

What to send us

  • Your field: size in hectares, plus a map or Google Earth screenshot if you have one
  • Your crop: what you grow, row spacing and plant spacing
  • Your water: borehole, dam, river or municipal, and how far it is from the field
  • Your land: which way it slopes, and roughly how high the water must be lifted
  • Your power: how many hours a day you can pump, and whether you have grid power, a generator or solar
After delivery

We don't disappear once it's installed

Aftersales support

Questions about setup, running or maintenance? Call or WhatsApp us and we'll help you keep your equipment working, long after the sale.

High-wear parts in stock

We keep common replacement parts — the ones that wear out fastest — in stock, so a broken part doesn't mean weeks of waiting for a shipment.
